chunks: Jābir ibn Yazīd al-Juʿfī asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a gecko falling into a well.
So he عليه السلام said: “It is nothing; stir the water with the bucket.”

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.الدَّلْوِ: the bucket used to stir or draw the water
key_terms.جَابِرُ: Jābir, the questioner and narrator in this report
key_terms.لَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ: it is of no consequence; it does not cause concern here

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a gecko falls into a well?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a gecko falling into well water. Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام states that it does not render the water problematic, and instructs that the water be stirred with a bucket.
